name: I Will Drown A Guy
storyline:
It is yet another day. You think. Your eyes crack open as you lay in your warm bed, allowing sunlight to stream into your sleep-encrusted eyeballs.

And speaking of streams, the memories of your dreams fade and your brain is suddenly consumed by thoughts of a Twitch streamer you once heard about - Guy Kelly. An actor and comedian man akin to Bo Burnham...if Bo Burnham was older, and unable to play music or sing, and could only partake in cryptic crosswords for the entertainment of the suspiciously horny public on a week-daily basis. A man who occasionally even starts his streams at the time he professes he will do so at.

Anyway, as you ponder upon this man, you begin to be slowly consumed with desire. No, not //that// sort of desire. Not the smutty kind.

The one where you wish to drown him.

That's right. You have awoken. And you really want to drown Guy Kelly.
summary:
Finally! A dark-comedy choose-your-own-adventure game written by me, actor and shenanigan-maker Emilia Copeland, about a man called Guy Kelly. A man who is apparently an actor and comedian. A man who definitely made a game about strangling a horse. A man who must now be drowned.

Can Guy Kelly even be drowned? Find out for yourself, in this 29k+ word game of delicious nonsense that will surprise absolutely no-one that knows me in person.
